LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Extensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Extensive Reading, part of Reading in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Which aspects can enhance understanding of a reading text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read different forms of greetings from their cultures to peers,

2. read texts about different people, their ages, their place of origin and residence, and answer questions,

3. listen to audios and read along texts of people introducing themselves (z.B. Ich heiße__/Ich bin___/Mein Name ist; Ich bin __Jahre alt/ich komme aus___/Ich wohne in___), write about themselves and read to peers,

4. listen/ read to texts of people introducing others (z.B. Er/sie heißt___/Er/sie ist___/Sein/ihr Name ist___; er/sie ist __Jahre alt/Er/sie kommt aus___/Er/sie

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read different forms of greetings from their cultures to peers,
2. read texts about different people, their ages, their place of origin and residence, and answer questions,
3. listen to audios and read along texts of people introducing themselves (z.B. Ich heiße__/Ich bin___/Mein Name ist; Ich bin __Jahre alt/ich komme aus___/Ich wohne in___), write about themselves and read to peers,
4. listen/ read to texts of people introducing others (z.B. Er/sie heißt___/Er/sie ist___/Sein/ihr Name ist___; er/sie ist __Jahre alt/Er/sie kommt aus___/Er/sie

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Extensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: learner enhances their understanding of who they are as they present about themselves to peers.

Values:
Respect: learner observes etiquette as they greet and introduce themselves and others to peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: learner develops awareness of the role of greetings and knowing others in maintaining social cohesion.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learner links this knowledge to the same acquired in English and Kiswahili on greetings and introduction.
